Stores a new secret in the caller's organization, encrypted. Agents and campaigns reference it as `${NAME}` in an `api_key`; cloud runs receive its value when they are claimed, and nothing else can read it back. 400 when the name is invalid or already used (replace a value with `PUT /secret/{name}`); 403 when the caller has no organization.
